en: Tax Havens - Countries that offer low or zero tax rates attracting wealthy individuals and businesses.
Tech Cold War - Rising tensions between the U.S. and China in the technology sector.
Thucydides Trap - When a rising power threatens to displace a ruling one, leading to potential conflict.
Tobin Tax - A proposal to tax all spot conversions of one currency into another.
Too Big to Fail - A concept asserting that certain businesses are so vital that it would be disastrous to let them collapse.
Trade Facilitation - The simplification and harmonization of international trade procedures.
Trade War - A situation where countries try to damage each other's trade by imposing tariffs.
Transnational Corporations - Companies that operate in more than one country.
Trickle-down Economics - The theory that economic benefits provided to the wealthy will eventually benefit broader segments of society.
Underbanked - Individuals or businesses that have insufficient access to mainstream financial services and products.
Unipolar World - A power structure dominated by a single superpower.
Unit Labor Costs - The average cost of labor per unit of output, calculated by dividing the total wages by the output.
Universal Basic Income (UBI) - A model for providing all citizens with a certain sum of money, regardless of income, resources, or employment status.
Value-added Tax (VAT) - A consumption tax placed on a product whenever value is added at each stage of the supply chain.
Viral Sovereignty - The principle that each nation has the rights to viruses originating within its borders.
Virtual Economy - An economy that exists in a virtual world, often in online games.
Virtual Water - The water embedded in the production of food and consumer products.
Washington Consensus - A set of 10 economic policy prescriptions considered to constitute the "standard" reform package for countries in crisis.
Weaponization of Trade - Using trade as a tool to punish or reward countries based on political decisions.
Whistleblower - A person who exposes secretive information or activity within a private or public organization.
Wholesale Banking - Banking services sold on a large scale to large institutions, corporations, and other banks.
X-efficiency - The efficiency with which a firm transforms a given set of inputs into outputs.
Yellow Vest Movement - A populist, grassroots political movement for economic justice that began in France in 2018.
Yield Curve Inversion - When short-term interest rates exceed long-term rates, often seen as a precursor to a recession.
Yield Spread - The difference between yields on differing debt instruments, calculated by deducting the yield of one instrument from another.
Youth Bulge - A demographic pattern where a substantial percentage of the population is comprised of children and young adults.
Zero-sum Game - A situation in which a gain for one side means a loss for another.
Zombie Bank - A financial institution with an economic net worth less than zero but continues to operate.
Zombie Companies - Firms that can't cover their debt servicing costs from operating profits over an extended period.
Zombie Debt - Old debt that is not collectible anymore but is brought back by debt collectors to try to recoup the money.
